messages:
nina: Heads-up — found a copy/paste footgun in the quickstart README. Someone pasted a literal token example into app code and it ended up in a public repo. SUP-4382.

maya: ugh. where exactly? :eyes:

nina: quickstart.md and the Node sample in the README. curl shows:

``nina: curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY' -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'
```

nina: but the Node snippet later includes:

``nina: const Redwood = require('@redwood/inference');
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: 'REPLACE_ME_WITH_YOUR_API_KEY' }); // <- literal token in example
const r = await client.generate({prompt: 'hi'});
```

sam: oh that literal string is the problem. people copy/paste that into repos.

alex: also worth clarifying behavior differences: the HTTP/curl path will 1:1 hit the API and you need to implement retries. our Node SDK auto-retries 429/5xx with exponential backoff by default. docs should call that out.

maya: agree. proposed fixes: remove any literal tokens, replace with process.env examples, add a short note about SDK retry behavior vs raw HTTP, and a tiny safe CLI pattern. I'll open a PR.

maya: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/612 — removes literal, switches Node to env var, adds note on retries and a one-liner curl-safe pattern (use env var, don't paste token). tagging @sam for review. :shipit:

docs-bot: New PR opened by maya: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/612 — title: "quickstart: remove literal API token + clarify retry behavior"

sam: will review in ~30m. also can we add an md-lint check that fails if REPLACE_ME or literal-looking bearer tokens are present in docs? simple grep in CI.

nina: yes please. that would have prevented SUP-4382.

alex: one more doc detail — add a tiny example showing how to disable SDK retries when callers need full control:

``alex: // Node SDK
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY, retries: 0 });
```

maya: good call. I'll include that in the PR.

nina: thanks team. after merge please ping support so we can close SUP-4382. :+1:
